messages:
alex: Heads-up — planning a Console/UI deploy today at 17:00 PT. Plan is light feature rollforward, not a big plumbing change. preflight -> staged edge sync -> smoke -> promote. Who can own the smoke verification?
megan: I can take smoke at 17:10 PT after the staged slot is promoted. Will run the checklist and hit you if anything flakey. :thumbsup:
jordan: I’ll be on deploy for edge invalidation and CDN TTL sync. I can run the invalidation batch and confirm headers.
lia: Quick Q — which CDN edge path are we invalidating? full prefix or single asset? I can script a targeted invalidate if we only need the new bundle.
jordan: Targeted: /console/static/v2/*bundle*. We'll avoid a full wildcard. I’ll paste the invalidate command after deploy.
alex: @megan @jordan thanks. Preflight results are green on staging, perf looks good. Note: if smoke fails, rollback plan is immediate slot-swap to the previous UI version and re-run CDN sync. Lia, can you stand by for a rollback asset check?
lia: Yep, I’ll validate the previous build hashes and signal when they’re ready.
sam: tagging deploy-bot to schedule the canary window and record deploy metadata. deploy-bot: "Scheduled deploy 2008456789 by alex for 2023-11-05T17:00:00-08:00. Canary window 10m. Auto-rollback disabled (manual)."
alex: Manual auto-rollback disabled — we’ll do a manual slot-swap if needed. Megan will confirm smoke then we’ll promote fully.
jordan: Invalidation command (CloudFront):
```
aws cloudfront create-invalidation --distribution-id E2ABCDE12345 --paths "/console/static/v2/*bundle*"
```
I’ll run that after the staged slot is live, then wait 90s and check edge responses.
megan: Smoke checklist (short): 1) console loads 3 core pages, 2) login + token refresh, 3) billing routes open, 4) embeddings view renders. Will post quick pass/fail.
alex: Thanks — I’ll monitor metrics and error spikes during the canary window. If anything >3% error delta or latency +150ms P95 we abort.
lia: Rollback prep done: old build hashes pinned and CDN invalidation payload ready. If we need to revert, message me and I’ll trigger the old slot and run the invalidate for previous assets.
sam: For audit: deploy runbook link — https://console.redwood/internals/deploy-runbooks/ui.
megan: Smoke done @17:11 PT — all checks green, no regressions noted. :white_check_mark:
alex: Promoting to full at 17:15 PT. Jordan, run the invalidate once promotion confirms.
jordan: Invalidation kicked at 17:16 PT. Checking edge responses now — 200s for new bundles from 3 sampled regions.
deploy-bot: "Invalidation  inv_0a1b2c processed, status COMPLETED."
alex: All good from my side, no error spikes. Recording rollout as success. Thanks everyone. :tada:
